origins.section: Looking a Method Up Costs More Than Calling It, So Look Up Once
Since JDK 18, Method.invoke Is Fast Only When the JIT Sees a Constant
A Method Handle Obeys the Same Rule, and invokeExact Never Boxes
The Pre-JDK 18 Reflection Won Only While One Method Used the Call Site
A Loop Whose Result Nobody Reads Measures Nothing

gates.says: all 5 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-mapper-lookup-per-call: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-mapper-lookup-per-call: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-mapper-lookup-per-call: 'Looking a Method Up Costs More...': lookupEachCall 26.6-27.1 ns/200 bytes vs invokeField ~5 ns; 'getMethod searches the class's public methods and hands back a new Method every time', shown by same object: false.
recorded.prompt:q-getter-holder: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-getter-holder: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-getter-holder: 'Since JDK 18, Method.invoke Is Fast Only When the JIT Sees a Constant': invokeConstant 1.13-1.36 vs invokeClassFinal 4.64-4.95; HotSpot trusts static finals, not ordinary final instance fields; JIT compiles the call to at into the loop when the Method is a constant ('the timings suggest' - slightly hedged).
recorded.prompt:q-small-ids: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-small-ids: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-small-ids: 'A Method Handle Obeys the Same Rule...': Boxes output, echo/small 0 bytes, big values 16 bytes each, 32 for both; 'Each value outside the cache costs a 16-byte Integer'.
recorded.prompt:q-old-flag: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-old-flag: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-old-flag: 'The Pre-JDK 18 Reflection Won Only While One Method Used the Call Site': 'others first useDirectMethodHandle=false' 4.86 vs 5.19-5.43 new; JIT 'no longer optimising through it' with four generated classes.
recorded.prompt:q-zero-ns: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-zero-ns: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-zero-ns: 'A Loop Whose Result Nobody Reads Measures Nothing': directDiscarded 0.00 ns, 'the JIT saw that no one used the result and deleted the loop'. Page's example discards the result outright rather than storing it in an unread local; equating the two is a small inference.

recorded.prompt:q-mapper-lookup-per-call:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-mapper-lookup-per-call:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-mapper-lookup-per-call:b: 'Since JDK 18...': only static final fields or record components via one are constants; 'A framework that keeps its Methods in maps ... is in the slow rows'.
recorded.prompt:q-mapper-lookup-per-call:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-mapper-lookup-per-call:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-mapper-lookup-per-call:c: accessibleEachCall (4.6-6.8) vs invokeField (4.9-5.7): repeating setAccessible 'cost at most half a nanosecond more, within the spread between JVMs', vs ~22 ns lookup.
recorded.prompt:q-mapper-lookup-per-call:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-mapper-lookup-per-call:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-mapper-lookup-per-call:d: Same accessibleEachCall vs invokeField rows: per-call setAccessible leaves invoke cost essentially unchanged, so it does not stop compilation. The page does not discuss JIT compilation of invoke per se; refuted by measured effect only.

recorded.pass:q-getter-holder:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-getter-holder:a: Page: HotSpot 'doesn't trust an ordinary final instance field ... so IN_CLASS.m costs as much as a non-final field'.

recorded.prompt:q-getter-holder:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-getter-holder:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-getter-holder:d: setAccessible (which skips the access check) saved only 0.3-0.9 ns in either location, far less than the ~4 ns gap; page attributes gap to JIT constant-folding. Page never states outright that location leaves the check unchanged, so refutation is by magnitude.
